channel.title: Versions
channel.description: This is version 1.0. The home page exists in every version, so the version switcher leads to the home page of each.

item.title: Stable
item.description: Exists under this path in every version. The switcher leads to stable in 2.0 and 3.0.

item.title: Moved
item.description: Moved to moved-b in 2.0 and to moved-c in 3.0. Both name this path as an alias, so the switcher leads to them.

item.title: Guide
item.description: Split into guide-install and guide-usage in 2.0. Only guide-install names this path as an alias, so the switcher leads there in 2.0 and 3.0.

item.title: Tab
item.description: Merged into tabs in 3.0, which names this path as an alias. The switcher leads to tab in 2.0 and to tabs in 3.0.

item.title: Tabs
item.description: Exists under this path in every version. The switcher leads to tabs in 2.0 and 3.0.

item.title: Removed
item.description: Exists in this version only. The switcher leads to the home page of 2.0 and 3.0.

item.title: Gap
item.description: Exists in 1.0 and 3.0 but not in 2.0. The switcher leads to the home page of 2.0 and to gap in 3.0.

item.title: Renamed
item.description: Renamed to renamed-new in 2.0, which got its alias only in 3.0. The switcher leads to the home page of 2.0 and to renamed-new in 3.0.
